marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 思如君王 | Si ru jun wang

As Christians, we are called to be the light of the world (Matthew 5:14-16) and to rise up in our God-given destiny to partner with like-minded people to transform cities and to make God's name known in all areas of society. However, unless we learn to think like the kings we were born to be, we will not be able to fulfill this mission effectively. The workplace is often dominated by 'every man for himself' thinking, leading many business people to pursue and achieve financial success, but often at great cost to their families, health, partners, reputation and faith. If you desire to break free from this culture, gain influence, mobilize resources, and achieve true success for the Kingdom of God, you must become a different-thinking person. This book will challenge, inspire, and equip you to do just that.
